notes: מִי־יִתֵּן is rendered here as an ordinary interrogative clause (*Who can find*) rather than the optative formula, so rule 30's fusion condition is unmet and each morpheme takes the English written for it (rule 2).
נִשְׂבָּע is anarthrous, so the supplied *one that* joins its unit, headed on *filled* and discontinuous around the negative (rules 46, 25).
